title: OpenL3
text: OpenL3 embeddings extraction network, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Spectrum type} sets Type of spectrum Mel; {Content type} sets the type of audio content, {Embedding length} sets the output embedding length and {Mini-batch size} sets the size of mini-batches. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Spectrum type
params.values: Type of spectrum Mel (128 bands) (default) | Mel (256 bands) | Linear

params.name: Content type
params.values: Type of audio content Environmental sounds (default) | Musical sounds
